beats.label: S1 · Shadow leaves prison
beats.text: Ex-con Shadow Moon leaves prison after his wife Laura dies in a crash beside his best friend Robbie, her secret lover.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Shadow's grief and the betrayal he carries into everything after.

beats.label: S1 · Wednesday hires him
beats.text: A conman calling himself Mr. Wednesday hires Shadow as bodyguard; Technical Boy's men soon try to lynch Shadow to send Wednesday a message.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Wednesday employment and the Old-vs-New God war Shadow gets pulled into.

beats.label: S1 · The coin and Laura returns
beats.text: Leprechaun Mad Sweeney loses a gold coin to Shadow, who throws it on Laura's grave; the coin resurrects her and she comes back to find him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Laura-Sweeney-coin tether drives most of what follows across two seasons.

beats.label: S1 · New Gods pressure Wednesday
beats.text: Media and Mr. World frame Wednesday and Shadow for bank robbery, then offer Wednesday an alliance he refuses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the New God antagonists and confirms the war is not going to be talked out.

beats.label: S1 · Recruiting the Old Gods
beats.text: Wednesday tours the country pulling Old Gods into an unspecified war, killing the gun-god Vulcan when Vulcan sells them out to the New Gods.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Wednesday's method and his willingness to kill his own kind, which recurs in S2.

beats.label: S1 · Sweeney's confession
beats.text: Sweeney tells Laura that Wednesday engineered both her death and Shadow's imprisonment, to isolate Shadow for a purpose he won't name.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The manipulation reveal that reshapes Laura's motives and eventually turns her against Wednesday.

beats.label: S1 · Odin declared
beats.text: Cornered at Easter's estate, Wednesday incinerates the New Gods' men, names himself Odin, and Shadow finally says out loud that he believes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The masks come off. War is declared and Shadow is committed for the first time.

cliffhanger.text: Wednesday has revealed himself as Odin and open war with the New Gods has begun. Shadow, finally a believer, turns to find Laura waiting for him.
questions: What war does Wednesday intend to wage now that he has shown his hand?
Can Shadow accept who Laura is now, and what she wants from him?
What does Wednesday actually want with Shadow, given Sweeney says he was chosen for a reason?

characters.name: Shadow Moon
characters.line: Ex-con widower and Wednesday's bodyguard, who at season's end has finally admitted the gods around him are real.

characters.name: Mr. Wednesday
characters.line: The conman who has just revealed himself as Odin, actively recruiting Old Gods for a war against the New.

characters.name: Laura Moon
characters.line: Shadow's dead wife, resurrected by Sweeney's coin, decaying but strong, standing in Shadow's hotel room.

characters.name: Mad Sweeney
characters.line: Leprechaun in Wednesday's employ, guilty over his role in Laura's death, tethered to her by the coin she now carries.

characters.name: Mr. World
characters.line: Leader of the New Gods, wants Wednesday allied or dead, just repelled by Odin at Easter's estate.

characters.name: Media
characters.line: Shape-shifting New Goddess of screens, working with Mr. World, appears as celebrities to persuade or threaten.

characters.name: Technical Boy
characters.line: Petulant New God of the internet, tried to lynch Shadow and was forced by Mr. World to apologise.

beats.label: S2 · Council at House on the Rock
beats.text: Wednesday rallies the Old Gods to his war; Shadow's speech wins them over, but Mr. World's men ambush them at a diner and kill Zorya.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First open blood between the two sides; commits the Old Gods and pushes Wednesday toward retaliation.

beats.label: S2 · Train ambush
beats.text: Mr. Town tortures Shadow for Wednesday's plans; Wednesday derails the train to free him, and Laura is torn apart in the crash.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Wednesday will sacrifice anyone, including Laura, to protect his son and his plan.

beats.label: S2 · Argus dies, New Media rises
beats.text: Media reincarnates as New Media, while Wednesday sends Laura to kill Argus, the New Gods' surveillance god, briefly restoring her body.
beats.whyLoadBearing: New Media becomes the New Gods' primary face for the rest of the arc; Argus's death cripples their surveillance.

beats.label: S2 · Hunt for the spear
beats.text: Salim and the Jinn recover Wednesday's spear Gungnir; the dwarves in a dying mall re-etch its runes, giving Wednesday his weapon back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gungnir is the weapon of the war. Where it is at any moment decides who can act.

beats.label: S2 · Wednesday as manipulator
beats.text: The story of Wednesday driving his own son Donar to suicide, plus Sweeney's warnings, mark him for Laura and Shadow as a man to distrust.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes Wednesday from ally to author of the tragedies around them; primes both Laura and Shadow to break with him.

beats.label: S2 · Sweeney dies on Gungnir
beats.text: Sweeney tries to spear Wednesday; Shadow blocks and Sweeney falls dead onto the point, then magics Gungnir into his otherworld hoard.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Wednesday's key weapon from play and gives Laura a body and a grievance to carry forward.

beats.label: S2 · Shadow is Wednesday's son
beats.text: Yggdrasil absorbs Shadow, who learns Wednesday is his father; he escapes with a new identity while Laura walks away with Sweeney's body.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reveal that reshapes everything: Shadow is a demigod being groomed, not a bodyguard being paid.

cliffhanger.text: Shadow has learned Wednesday is his father, taken a new identity, and gone north alone. Laura carries Sweeney's body and has decided to kill Wednesday. Gungnir is hidden.
questions: Now that Shadow knows he's Wednesday's son, will he stay bought or break with him?
Can Wednesday's war continue with Gungnir locked in Sweeney's hoard?
Will Laura find and kill Wednesday, and will Shadow try to stop her?

characters.name: Shadow Moon
characters.line: Demigod son of Wednesday, fleeing north under a new identity given to him by the World Tree.

characters.name: Mr. Wednesday
characters.line: Odin, still driving toward war, but his spear is locked away and his son is alienated.

characters.name: Laura Moon
characters.line: Now knows Wednesday orchestrated her death, carries Sweeney's corpse, and has resolved to kill Wednesday.

characters.name: Mad Sweeney
characters.line: Dead by Gungnir. Before dying he stashed the spear in his otherworld hoard where Wednesday cannot reach it.

characters.name: Mr. World
characters.line: Leader of the New Gods, escalating the war and 'retired' Technical Boy for failure.

characters.name: New Media
characters.line: Media's reincarnated form, sleeker and more aggressive, weaponising manipulation for Mr. World.

characters.name: Technical Boy
characters.line: Killed and reborn as Quantum Boy, having uploaded a mass of data into Mr. World and New Media's hands.

characters.name: Salim
characters.line: Left with the Jinn to hide from the war, no longer in Wednesday's service.

characters.name: Bilquis
characters.line: Old Goddess of love, shaken by Zorya's death, drifting between sides after Anansi pressed her to fight.

beats.label: S3 · Shadow hides in Lakeside
beats.text: Three months on, Shadow hides in the northern town of Lakeside as 'Mike Ainsel,' while a local girl's disappearance draws him into the town's secret.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Shadow's new life, the setting for most of his season, and the mystery that keeps him grounded there.

beats.label: S3 · Ms. World and the Shard
beats.text: Mr. World becomes Ms. World and launches Shard, a global tech project designed to convert or eliminate the Old Gods for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The New Gods' endgame gets a name and a mechanism; every later New God plot ties to Shard.

beats.label: S3 · Wednesday courts Demeter
beats.text: Wednesday commits himself to a psych ward to win back his ex-wife Demeter; she agrees to leave the facility but refuses him, breaking him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Demeter's rejection is the private failure that softens Wednesday and sets up his 'peace' overture at season's end.

beats.label: S3 · Bilquis awakens
beats.text: Captured for the Shard project, Bilquis awakens to new spiritual powers, reconnects to the African gods, and stops feeding on worshipers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Bilquis from the war's binary sides and positions her as a wildcard who sees Shadow's larger destiny.

beats.label: S3 · Technical Boy is Prometheus
beats.text: Glitching apart, Technical Boy learns from Mr. World that he is the ancient god Prometheus, and gets locked in a vault for the trouble.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recasts a New God as an Old one and hints Mr. World is not what he says either.

beats.label: S3 · Laura kills Wednesday
beats.text: Ms. World feeds Laura Wednesday's location; using Sweeney's coin for luck, she spears Wednesday dead at what he had called a peace summit.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's inflection: the Old Gods' figurehead is dead by his own wife's daughter-in-law and the New Gods' setup.

beats.label: S3 · Shadow on the tree
beats.text: Honouring the Norse vigil, Shadow hangs from the World Tree and learns Wednesday engineered his death to harvest Shadow's demigod blood as sacrifice.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The whole con Sweeney warned about, revealed: Shadow was groomed to be the sacrifice, and he dies giving Wednesday power.

cliffhanger.text: Wednesday is dead by Laura's spear but his corpse has vanished from the vigil, having claimed Shadow's demigod blood as sacrifice. Shadow has died on the World Tree. Mr. Ibis warns something worse than the death of the Old Gods is coming.
questions: What does Wednesday become now that Shadow's demigod blood has been sacrificed to him?
Who is Mr. World really, if he is likely not a New God?
Will Shadow return from the World Tree, and on whose side if he does?

characters.name: Shadow Moon
characters.line: Wednesday's demigod son, hanged on the World Tree as the blood sacrifice his father engineered him into.

characters.name: Mr. Wednesday
characters.line: Killed by Laura, but his corpse has vanished from the vigil site after taking Shadow's power in death.

characters.name: Laura Moon
characters.line: Alive again, free of the coin, killed Wednesday with a lucky throw and is now estranged from Shadow.

characters.name: Ms. World
characters.line: Transformed head of the New Gods, running Shard to erase the Old, and likely not a New God herself.

characters.name: Technical Boy
characters.line: Revealed by Mr. World to be Prometheus, the original fire-god, locked away in his vault.

characters.name: Bilquis
characters.line: Awakened Old Goddess who no longer needs to feed on worshipers and has foreseen Shadow's larger destiny.

characters.name: Salim
characters.line: Out of the war, in love with a new man, having made peace with the loss of the Jinn.

characters.name: Mr. Ibis
characters.line: Old God undertaker who has just watched Wednesday's corpse vanish and warns something far worse is coming.
